data.value: Before copying anything, DeployCraft always checks that the computer responds (DNS name and file share). These settings say what to do if it does not.

data.value: Retry later instead of marking the computer as failed

data.value: The computer stays “Waiting” in the deployment until the next attempt. Restarting the DeployCraft service drops the pending attempts.

data.name: OfflineEditor_WakeHint
data.value: The computer must have network wake-up enabled (BIOS and network card). Its MAC address is learned at the first successful deployment; from one subnet to another, the router must let the wake-up packet through.

data.name: PackageWindow_MessageWait
data.value: Wait for the user to click OK before the next step

data.value: With a duration: waits until the click or the end of the display. Without a duration: a message still open at the end of the step's timeout makes it fail.

data.value: Unchecked: the installation waits for clicks nobody will make, unless it runs in the logged-on user's session.

data.value: Use the Preferences settings (Options › Preferences › Offline)

data.value: Pull: each computer reads the share itself (\\server\… paths only; otherwise push).

data.value: Restart: DeployCraft waits for the computer to come back (at most the step's timeout), then moves on to the next step. Shutdown: the following steps are skipped.

data.name: PackageWindow_RebootMessageHint
data.value: Optional: shown to the logged-on user with the countdown.

data.value: Shut down the computer instead of restarting it

data.name: ServiceWindow_ManualStart
data.value: (started by hand, not as a Windows service)

data.value: Restart the DeployCraft service? Running deployments will be interrupted; the console reconnects by itself.

data.name: Settings_ThemeHint
